summary: Strengthen safety culture leadership with practical diagnostics, worker-voice mapping and action planning. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Safety culture leadership training helps operational leaders, safety professionals and line managers assess how worker voice shapes everyday risk controls. Participants practise diagnosing safety climate feedback, applying the hierarchy of controls, learning from incidents and setting measurable follow-up actions for leadership review. The focus is on practical leadership decisions, not implementing a full safety management system.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits people who shape safety expectations, respond to workplace concerns or report safety performance. It is designed for roles that influence how leaders and workers identify risks, discuss incidents and follow through on corrective actions.
modules: Hierarchy of Controls in Leadership Decisions
Safety Culture Improvement and Leadership Reporting
prerequisites: Prior exposure to workplace safety procedures or responsibility for supervising or advising on workplace safety is expected. No coding or programming is required.
